Proposed Development on Vacant Property APNs 8615-019-028 and 8615-019-0283 (UP/DR2023-20/ TTM-84241) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a Tentative Tract Map/Use Permit/ Design Review No. DR-2023-20 request for a proposed small lot single family residential subdivision with 35 two-story homes of either 1,540 square feet or 1,646 square feet each. The subject lots are accessible from W. 1st Street between Aspan Avenue and Barbara Ave. The proposed project includes two affordable units as prescribed under California?s Density Bonus law, for which development standard waivers are requested. A private street is proposed with access both from 1st Street and Duell St. Proposed exterior materials include siding, stucco and vinyl windows. Maximum height for the proposed units is 28 feet. The project is Categorically Exempt from CEQA (Class 32- Infill Development).
